window: 2026-07-30 through 2026-09-06. Later reports and current source take precedence over earlier claims within it; every retained prior finding recorded as still-open was re-read against current source rather than carried on the earlier report's authority. Revision 2 (same day) adds a built-artifact reproduction and the CE-series coupling survey.
method: Static read of current source at HEAD bd17f61 with an uncommitted README.md, plus three commands actually run (recorded under fresh_tests). Route auth was assessed by a regex scan over .route(...) registrations cross-referenced against handler bodies, then by hand-reading the handlers the scan flagged. Membership in this index is NOT adjudication of every claim inside an indexed artifact: the 2026-07-30 audit is indexed and six of its findings were re-verified, but 21 of its findings were not re-examined. Source hashes fingerprint the tree so later drift is detectable — they are not evidence of line-by-line review. No HTTP request was made against a running strivo-web; every auth finding is a code-reading inference, not an executed request. Revision 2 additionally BUILT the PVR web assets (`cargo build -p strivo-web`) and inspected the emitted bundle directly — that artifact, not the stripper's source, is the evidence for S10. The source spa.js in the build worktree hashes identically to the baseline fingerprint (e46d9a08…), binding the artifact to unmodified source. The CE-series rests on reading Cargo manifests and counting cfg sites; no split was attempted, not even as a spike.
exclusions: Credentials, API keys, session secrets and OAuth tokens — none read, none recorded, none quoted.
The user's real config.toml, keyring entries and recording library — not read; no live daemon was contacted.
target/ build artifacts and node_modules — not indexed.
The 21 findings of the 2026-07-30 audit not re-verified this pass — indexed as an artifact, not adjudicated.

route_auth_scan.method: Python regex over .route("path", method(handler)) registrations in crates/strivo-web/src/routes/*.rs, cross-referenced against each handler body for a call to authed/check_key/check_dual.
